Subject: StellaWorks MSA & Order Form — signer roster and notary ask

Hi Priyom / Laura,

Thanks for sending the redlines over last night. Attached are our counter-sign edits (StellaWorks_MSA_final_redlines_20260623.pdf) and a cleaned Order Form v3. Two quick asks from legal/procurement before we circulate the DocuSign envelope: 

1) Signer roster & authority: we need the exact name(s), title(s), and email addresses of the Redwood exec(s) who will sign the MSA and the Order Form. For audit we also need the company authority (POA or board resolution) for any signatory who is signing on behalf of Redwood.

2) Notarization clarification: our finance team flagged that the Order Form for this deployment needs a notarized signature for the payment/escrow appendix because the counterparty is an LP vehicle. If Redwood can provide an exception or a witness flow (DocuSign-supported) that would speed things up; otherwise we will require a notarized wet signature for the payment addendum only.

3) DocuSign sequencing: StellaWorks prefers that we sign first (we want the envelope to be routed: StellaWorks Legal -> Redwood execs -> StellaWorks final countersign). Can Redwood confirm whether a reversal (Redwood sign first) is needed for your internal processes?

We also want a final, single PDF clean copy (no comment stamps) to be archived in our contract repository after execution and the audit trail exported from DocuSign.

Attachments: StellaWorks_MSA_final_redlines_20260623.pdf; OrderForm_v3_attached.docx

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if easier.

Thanks,
Dana
Dana King
Head of Legal Operations
StellaWorks

Subject: Re: StellaWorks MSA & Order Form — signer roster and notary ask

Hi Dana,

Appreciate the clear list. Quick responses and proposed plan below.

Proposed signer roster (Redwood):
- Markus O. Klein (CEO) — markus.klein@redwoodinference.com — primary MSA signer
- Laura Bennett (CRO) — laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com — secondary, Order Form authority

We will provide a signed POA/board confirmation for Markus by EOD tomorrow. Laura — can you confirm the POA upload once you have it?

Notarization: we can support an embedded witness flow in DocuSign for the payment appendix (so no need for a wet-ink return), but that requires a witness recipient and a brief identity check. If StellaWorks still requires a notarized page, we can arrange a single wet-ink notarization for the appendix only and upload a notarized PDF to the DocuSign envelope. Which do you prefer?

DocuSign sequencing: Redwood prefers to be second signer for one reason — our internal finance approval gate expects the Order Form to pass through our accounting reviewer prior to final signature. Proposed routing: StellaWorks (internal sign) -> Redwood (Markus, then Laura) -> StellaWorks final countersign. This keeps procurement checks in order and still matches your audit needs.

Next steps: 
- I will assemble the execution packet (preview attached: execution-packet-preview.pdf) and create the envelope with the proposed recipients and tags.
- Laura to confirm authority documentation upload and confirm if Markus will sign in-person or via DocuSign.
- Dana to confirm whether StellaWorks needs the notarized wet signature or will accept witness flow.

If you prefer a brief sync, I can set 15 min tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Priyom — this all looks good. Two clarifications: 

- Witness vs notarization: StellaWorks Legal is fine with an embedded witness + identity check for the payment appendix (preferred). Please add a witness recipient (name: Tom Alvarez, tom.alvarez@stellaworks.com) and configure the DocuSign recipient type as "Witness" with an ID check required.

- Sign order: we confirm StellaWorks will sign first. Please set the routing so that our initial execution is at sequence 1, Redwood execs sequence 2, then our final countersign sequence 3. The envelope should include two separate documents: (A) the MSA (no notarization) and (B) the Order Form + payment appendix (witness flow).

We will perform a quick dry-run on our side once you send the test envelope.

One more ask: for audit purposes, can Redwood include a single PDF labeled "Redwood_execution_packet_FINAL.pdf" in the envelope so both parties can download the post-exec combined clean copy in one click?

Attn: Laura — please forward the POA to me when available so we can keep it with our file.

Best,
Dana
